page_title: NAP 1-0 SAS | Napoli v Sassuolo 17/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Matteo Politano (Napoli) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
90+2' Matteo Politano (Napoli) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

90+2' The opposition back off Matteo Politano (Napoli) and he lashes in a shot from the edge of the box that just flies a whisker wide of the left post. Unlucky! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Luca Moro (Sassuolo) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Luca Lipani.
89' Fabio Grosso has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Walid Cheddira (Sassuolo) replacing Andrea Pinamonti.
88' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
84' A yellow card for a tackle by Edoardo Iannoni (Sassuolo). Francesco Fourneau doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
84' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Laurs Skjellerup (Sassuolo).
81' Fabio Grosso prepares a substitution. Alieu Fadera is replaced by Laurs Skjellerup (Sassuolo).
81' Substitution. Josh Doig will be replaced by Woyo Coulibaly (Sassuolo).
78' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) gets to the rebound outside the penalty box and unleashes a long-range shot towards the left post, but Arijanet Muric makes a decent save to stop the effort.
78' The corner from Matteo Politano (Napoli) is hurriedly cleared.
74' Scott McTominay (Napoli) superbly rides the challenge and bends a shot in from distance that flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
74' Sassuolo control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
72' A raking crossfield pass from Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
69' Scott McTominay is not given a chance to finish after receiving a sweet pass by Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli).
67' Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) comes onto the pitch because Amir Rrahmani simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
64' Fabio Grosso is stunned as referee Francesco Fourneau shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
62' Cristian Stellini has decided to make a change. Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) replaces Antonio Vergara.
59' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) sends a long ball in, but Arijanet Muric comfortably gathers the ball.
57' Substitution. Sam Beukema leaves the pitch and is replaced by Noa Lang (Napoli).
57' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Matteo Politano (Napoli) is coming onto the pitch as Eljif Elmas cannot continue after picking up an injury.
56' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

55' Nemanja Matic (Sassuolo) has a shot blocked, it rebounds back to him, but even on his second attempt he cannot hit the target. His effort goes well wide. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
54' The game has come to an end for Aster Vranckx. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Edoardo Iannoni (Sassuolo).
53' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Aster Vranckx (Sassuolo) is given a yellow card.
53' Scott McTominay (Napoli) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
50' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) took the corner.

49' Luca Lipani (Sassuolo) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom right corner, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
48' Antonio Vergara (Napoli) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The end of the first half.

45+1' Antonio Vergara (Napoli) tries his luck from long range, but it doesn't give the goalkeeper anything to worry about as it goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle. Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) commits a foul after dangerous play. Napoli have been awarded a free kick.

42' What a great effort! Scott McTominay (Napoli) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the left post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.

40' That was a poorly executed free kick from long distance. Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) was trying to produce a cross into the penalty area, but his effort sailed off the pitch. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
39' Poor challenge! Juan Jesus (Napoli) is penalised for tripping and Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle. Sassuolo are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.

36' Aster Vranckx (Sassuolo) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and attempts to place his header into the bottom right corner. Vanja Milinkovic-Savic shows his fast reflexes, though, and makes a nice save.
36' The corner from Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) is intercepted by the defence.

34' Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) is free in the box and Armand Lauriente finds him with a pass, but his powerful shot skims just past the right post. Good chance! The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
33' Nemanja Matic (Sassuolo) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Napoli have a free kick.
32' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.

31' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Vanja Milinkovic-Savic pulls off an easy save.
30' Antonio Vergara (Napoli) jumps into a tackle and Francesco Fourneau signals a foul.
29' Sam Beukema (Napoli) jumps for a header from the resulting corner kick and sends the ball in on goal, but the goalkeeper makes a very good save.
29' Antonio Vergara (Napoli) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

27' Nemanja Matic (Sassuolo) makes a good late run into the box and times his jump perfectly to get on the end of the corner kick, but his close-range header is brilliant blocked to deny him a certain goal.
27' There's an opportunity for Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
27' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Sassuolo have a corner.
24' The corner from Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) is cleared away by the defence.
21' Nemanja Matic (Sassuolo) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle for a foul. Napoli have a free kick.
19' Luca Lipani (Sassuolo) misses the left post by a whisker with a mid-range rebound. What a chance that was! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.

17' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) meets a cross from Leonardo Spinazzola, but he cannot keep his header on target. It goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
16' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
14' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
11' Francesco Fourneau interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Luca Lipani (Sassuolo). There is a free kick near the sideline to Napoli.
10' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his low effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.

7' 1 - 0 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a strong shot into the top of the net. His attempt was beyond the reach of Arijanet Muric, so the score changes to 1:0.
7' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the left post. Arijanet Muric is alert and denies him with a nice save.
6' The resulting corner from Antonio Vergara (Napoli) comes to nothing.
5' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Antonio Vergara (Napoli).
4' Arijanet Muric steps in and intercepts a long pass from Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli).
3' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) connects with the corner but his looping header goes well over. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
2' Antonio Vergara (Napoli) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
2' Antonio Vergara (Napoli) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Napoli are awarded a corner kick.
1' The first half has started.
Sassuolo will kick the game off.
Francesco Fourneau will supervise the game today.
